en.answer:
No, you cannot.

Xyz Summoning a monster, and Special Summoning a monster (with the Summon being treated as an Xyz Summon), are not the same thing.
When a monster is Xyz Summoned, you can activate <<4861>> to negate that Xyz Summon. If a monster is Special Summoned (with the Summon being treated as an Xyz Summon), you cannot.
If you want to activate <<4861>> in the situation you describe, you need to activate it in response to the card activation of <<10541>>.

~~~

en.question: My opponent's <<10541>> resolves, Special Summoning (treated as an Xyz Summon) a monster from the Extra Deck. Can I activate <<4861>> during that attempt to Summon?
en.title: Can I activate <<4861>> when a monster would be Special Summoned, if that Special Summon is treated as a Synchro, Xyz, or Link Summon?
